# Hamdaz Technologies

> Hamdaz Technologies is an Abu Dhabi system integrator for AI, cloud, cybersecurity, MCC-certified CCTV and ELV, audio visual, networking and software development. We design, install and support the technology organisations run on, across the UAE.

Hamdaz Technologies is a system integrator based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with an office in Kozhikode, India. It is ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified, Abu Dhabi MCC certified for CCTV, and a registered ADNOC supplier (ICV).

## Company
- [Hamdaz Technologies | IT, AI, Cybersecurity & ELV in Abu Dhabi](https://hamdaz.com/): Abu Dhabi system integrator for AI, cloud, cybersecurity, MCC-certified CCTV, audio visual, networking and software. ISO certified, registered ADNOC supplier.
- [About Hamdaz Technologies | Abu Dhabi System Integrator](https://hamdaz.com/about.html): Hamdaz Technologies is an Abu Dhabi system integrator with delivery teams in Kerala, India: ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001, MCC and ICV certified, and an ADNOC supplier.
- [Clients & Projects in Abu Dhabi and the UAE](https://hamdaz.com/projects.html): Selected Hamdaz projects for ADNOC, Mohamed Bin Zayed University and more: MCC-certified CCTV, access control, ANPR, data centres and cabling in the UAE.
- [Clients & Technology Partners | ADNOC, Microsoft, Cisco](https://hamdaz.com/partners.html): Hamdaz clients across the UAE, including ADNOC group companies, and 41 technology partners such as Microsoft, Cisco, Dell, Fortinet and Hikvision.
- [Quality & QHSE | ISO 9001, 14001 & 45001 Certified](https://hamdaz.com/quality.html): Hamdaz is ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified by Bureau Veritas (UKAS). Our QHSE policy and how quality, safety and the environment are managed on every project.

- [Careers at Hamdaz | Jobs in Abu Dhabi & Kerala](https://hamdaz.com/careers.html): Open roles at Hamdaz Technologies in Abu Dhabi and Kozhikode: AI, cloud, cybersecurity, ELV and security systems, audio visual and software development. Apply online.
